description: Minimal seed fixture so the application runs end to end. It is not the production corpus: the team's database will replace it behind the CaseRepository interface.

review.method: Each passage was extracted programmatically from the fetched source page using start/end anchors, so excerpts are verbatim. Claims were written against those passages and checked by hand on 2026-10-24.
limitations: nasa.gov refused connections on 2026-10-24, so NASA pages were read from Internet Archive snapshots of the same URLs (noted per source).
Each case currently rests on one institutional account; independent corroboration has not been added.
